0.title: Real-time communication
0.text: I built WebSocket-based chat systems for two very different platforms — healthcare and tourism — including disconnect handling and session synchronization.

1.title: Applied geolocation
1.text: I built voice-guided, turn-by-turn navigation using OpenStreetMap and Leaflet to guide tourists to points of interest across Angola.

2.title: AI applied to product
2.text: I integrated the Google Gemini API to build "Kamba," a tourism guide chatbot, after evaluating alternatives like Groq and Cohere.

3.title: Software for the public sector
3.text: I developed and redesigned interfaces for government platforms, focused on visual trust and accessibility for everyday citizens.
